theme.archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SOFT UTILITY (Warm Japanese Tea & Matte Ceramic)
theme.description: Chill, simplistic, calm digital sanctuary. Avoids high-intensity neon or generic SaaS blue. Uses soothing matte tones, paper-like warmth, refined borders, and gentle tactile surfaces.

typography.font_family_heading: Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: Plus Jakarta Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
font_rules: Headings must NEVER use generic Inter or Space Grotesk (strictly prohibited).
H1 Ceiling rule: Max text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl. Subtitle must stay within 2 tailwind steps (text-lg to text-xl).
Overlines/Kickers must be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em], text-stone-500.
Track titles & scrobble stamps use mono or clean sans for precision.

forbidden_colors: pure saturated neon greens or harsh rainbow gradients

surface_strategy.cards: Warm solid ceramic surfaces (bg-white/90 or dark:bg-[#1A1918]/90) with crisp 1px borders (border-[#E6E2D8] or dark:border-[#2D2C2A]), soft ambient shadow (shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)]), and rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl corners.
surface_strategy.nav_bar: Floating crystal pill nav with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-[#121211]/80 border border-stone-200/80 dark:border-stone-800/80 px-6 py-3 shadow-sm
surface_strategy.social_chips: Tactile interactive pills with auto-favicon, subtle border, smooth hover lift (-translate-y-0.5), crisp high-contrast active states
surface_strategy.discord_card: Lush custom card showcasing user banner (with gradient fallbacks if null), high-res circular avatar with online status ring, Discord tag badge with copy-to-clipboard, custom status text, and connected badge
surface_strategy.lastfm_card: Vinyl record groove animation, equalizer bars (animating when track is currently playing), album art with soft drop-shadow, track name, artist, scrobble relative timestamp, and live Last.fm link

landing_page.hero_section: Asymmetric bento layout. Left col: masked line-by-line editorial headline, calm narrative copy, instant username claim CTA box. Right col: live interactive mock preview card of a public profile (/demo) with floating Discord widget & spinning vinyl Last.fm track.
landing_page.editorial_ribbon: Slow drifting marquee (react-fast-marquee or framer-motion) with serif typography showcasing connected platforms (Spotify, Discord, Last.fm, GitHub, Substack, YouTube, Instagram, X/Twitter).
landing_page.feature_bento: Tetris-style grid (md:grid-cols-12 gap-6) highlighting: 1. Auto-Favicon Engine (col-span-12 md:col-span-7), 2. Live Last.fm Scrobble Groove (col-span-12 md:col-span-5), 3. Discord Banner & Presence Mirror (col-span-12 md:col-span-6), 4. Minimalist Shareable Link /username (col-span-12 md:col-span-6).
landing_page.interactive_playground: Live preview sandbox where visitors can type any domain or paste a mock Discord ID to see live chip rendering and banner extraction.
landing_page.footer: Deep calm footer with massive subtle brandmark typography, privacy-first pledge, fast navigation links.

public_profile_page.structure: Focused, distraction-free container (max-w-xl mx-auto px-4 py-12 sm:py-16). 1. Header (Avatar, Display Name, Bio with warm markdown links, pronouns/location pill). 2. Discord Presence Card (Banner background, animated status, copy Discord ID). 3. Last.fm Live Groove (Now Playing pulsing vinyl + 3 recent scrobbles accordion). 4. Social Links Stack (Dynamic auto-favicon icons, click count or preview). 5. Subtle 'Made with Sanctuary' badge.

settings_dashboard.structure: Clean 2-column layout on desktop: Left sidebar / tab list (Profile & Bio, Discord Connection, Last.fm Scrobbler, Social Links Manager, Appearance & SEO). Right live preview pane that updates in real-time as user changes inputs.

motion_and_interactions.feel: Slow, soft, weighty, premium (duration: 0.5s to 0.8s, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1])

animations.name: hero_text_reveal
animations.description: Masked upward reveal for header lines (overflow-hidden wrapper with initial: {y: '100%'} animate: {y: 0})

animations.name: staggered_cards
animations.description: Staggered fade-up for profile links and bento widgets (staggerChildren: 0.08)

animations.name: vinyl_spin
animations.description: Slow continuous rotation (animate: {rotate: 360}, transition: {repeat: Infinity, duration: 12, ease: 'linear'}) when Last.fm is 'now_playing'

animations.name: equalizer_bars
animations.description: Gentle fluctuating heights (scaleY animate between 0.3 and 1) for currently playing track

animations.name: favicon_pop
animations.description: Subtle scale spring (initial: {scale: 0.8, opacity: 0} animate: {scale: 1, opacity: 1}) when URL domain is recognized

favicon_autodetection_rules.engine: Dynamic domain extractor with fallback cascade: 1. Google Favicon Service (https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain={domain}&sz=128), 2. DuckDuckGo Icons (https://icons.duckduckgo.com/ip3/{domain}.ico), 3. Dedicated Lucide/Brand icon mapping for top 30 platforms (GitHub, Twitter/X, Discord, YouTube, Spotify, Last.fm, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Threads, Mastodon, Bluesky, Substack, Medium, Dribbble, Figma, Behance, SoundCloud, Steam, Reddit, Email, Website).

curated_assets.description: Minimalist aesthetic mannequin head with headphones on dark wood audio unit
Aesthetic fingers gently browsing vinyl record sleeves in blue moody light
Warm ambient amber yellow lamp beside minimalist plant on wooden desk
Clean modern 3D clay-style avatar with blue cap on soft warm background
Pastel iridescent artistic bust silhouette with dreamlike textures

architecture_and_routes: Route '/': Landing page with value proposition, live interactive profile preview playground, feature bento, testimonials/examples showcase, and registration CTA.
Route '/:username': Public profile view for any user. Renders Discord card, Last.fm now playing widget, and social link chips. Accessible to everyone without login.

Route '/settings': Protected settings dashboard allowing the user to update bio, Discord User ID (with instant preview & test fetch), Last.fm username (with recent scrobbles test), and add/edit/reorder social links with instant favicon autodetection.
Route '/login' and '/register': Minimalist warm authentication modals/pages with demo 1-click accounts.
backend_mock_and_real_integrations: Provide robust backend API endpoints in FastAPI (/api/profile/{username}, /api/user/settings, /api/discord/lookup/{discord_id}, /api/lastfm/scrobbles/{username}).

For Discord integration: Implement lookup endpoint using public Discord user API or Lanyard / Discord snowflake resolver (with realistic mock fallback when rate limited or offline so Discord banner, avatar, custom status, and discriminator render flawlessly).

For Last.fm integration: Support public Last.fm 2.0 API (user.getrecenttracks) using user-provided API key or built-in service key with realistic rich scrobble mock data fallback (track title, artist, album art, scrobble date, is_now_playing indicator).
For Favicon detection: Backend or client helper extracting hostname and providing high-res favicon URLs from Google & DDG favicon CDN plus fallback SVG icons.
testing_data_testid_convention: All buttons, inputs, links, and key cards MUST have specific kebab-case data-testid tags (e.g. data-testid='claim-username-input', data-testid='discord-id-input', data-testid='social-link-item-0', data-testid='lastfm-now-playing-card', data-testid='save-settings-button').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 to p-12 on desktop cards. Give 80px+ vertical padding between sections.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Ensure WCAG AA contrast compliance: text must meet 4.5:1 ratio against background. Hover states must explicitly set text and background color.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_center_trap: Use asymmetric alignment, left-aligned headers with offset right interactive previews.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_generic_gradients: Avoid full screen vibrant gradients. Use tactile matte colors with subtle 1px borders and soft diffuse shadows.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for toasts (saved settings, copied Discord ID, invalid URL warnings).
